metadata.title: Branched Covers and Fiberwise Degeneration along Weak Kähler Geodesics
metadata.abstract: On the projective line, we construct a pair of smooth Kähler potentials whose weak geodesic has isolated quadratic zeros of the fiber form at two fixed points throughout an interior time interval. The geodesic is smooth near these zeros, and its space-time form has constant rank one there. For the same fixed endpoints, the minimum fiber eigenvalue of the nondegenerate Monge-Ampère approximations tends to zero, answering AIMPL Problem 2.5 in the negative. The construction works on every compact connected Riemann surface with a prescribed Kähler form and realizes any positive even order of vanishing. Taking products yields higher-dimensional examples in which the fiber rank drops by one along a smooth hypersurface while the space-time form retains maximal rank nearby. The proof starts from a semipositive model built from a branched cover. We make its endpoints strictly positive by local corrections and use comparison along holomorphic curves to prove that the weak geodesic still agrees with the model on an explicit interior region. There a ramification point of local degree $m$ gives a fiber zero of order exactly $2m-2$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 分支覆盖导致弱Kähler测地线纤维退化
analysis.workSummary: 在P¹、ω=2ω_FS上给一对固定光滑严格Kähler端点，其弱测地线在0、∞附近与分支模型一致，t∈[1/4,3/4]时纤维形式有孤立二次零点，时空形式在整个邻域恒秩1。精确局部系数为16e^(2t)/(1+e^(2t))²乘|ξ|²，加O(|ξ|⁴)。定理5.1扩至任意给定Kähler形式的紧连通曲面，在共同时间区间(3/8,5/8)每个分支点的纤维零阶为2m−2。
techniques: Darvas–McCleerey log-sum测地模型的分支覆盖描述
非负局部端点修正与周围正性吸收截断Hessian
紧带边界全纯零曲线上的最大值比较
分支值Möbius归一化及背景面积匹配
严格次解、Bedford–Taylor比较与固定端点逼近
analysis.breakthrough: 端点修正的非负、支撑与端点正性保证显式内部区域精确保持模型，无额外范数小性要求。在曲面上能实现任意正偶数零阶；积C×Y上沿{p}×Y纤维秩为n−1，附近时空秩仍为n。对固定端点的(θ+dd^cU_δ)²=δχ²逼近，0≤U−U_δ≤C√δ，并对固定内部时刻和固定小闭盘K有min_K λ_(δ,t)→0。
analysis.limitations: 逼近结论是每个固定t与K的最小特征值趋零，未声称在分支点本身的Hessian点态收敛或全时一致收敛。与Xiao–Yao既有严格纤维正性反例相比，本构造突出孤立定阶零点且总形式保持最大秩。小修正是相对半正模型，完整端点不在Hu全局小数据正性范围内。弱解存在、C¹,¹及非退化Dirichlet解依所引外部定理；本次未独立核验整篇证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第15页明确ChatGPT用于文献检索，特别是查找和修改main ansatz，计算修正函数b(z)，检查论证及语言编辑。主ansatz的具体构造用途明确，记ideas，并分别记录literature、computation、verification、writing。作者同时说明AI辅助不构成独立数学核验并承担责任。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.07451v1 · PDF第15页 Use of generative AI
